outcome: A versioned supported release has reproducible live delivery, operational and value evidence.
currentProblem: Completing individual tasks is insufficient without a release-level capability and value acceptance.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.
successCriteria: All prerequisite feature evidence is delivered and release acceptance reproduces supported entry, change, recovery and independent QA behavior.
A clean operator environment reproduces installation and representative delivery on the exact release; documentation matches supported capabilities.
Predeclared product value gate passes and known limitations are explicit; no release claim relies solely on merged source, CI or agent success.
